definitions.gloss: death toll; number of deaths; fatalities
definitions.explanation: The count of people killed by a disaster, accident, epidemic, or conflict. Standard news vocabulary, usually paired with {負傷者数|ふしょうしゃすう} (number of injured).

examples.japanese: {死者数|ししゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死者数|ししゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{確定|かくてい}→確定：13707_kakutei⟧⟦していない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The death toll from the earthquake has not yet been confirmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通事故|こうつうじこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死者数|ししゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{十年|じゅうねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of traffic-accident deaths has fallen sharply compared with ten years ago.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{死者|ししゃ}→死者：13225_shisha⟧ (the dead, a fatality) plus the suffix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number of). The suffix is highly productive: {参加者数|さんかしゃすう} (number of participants), ⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧ (number of infected).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死者数|ししゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: for the death toll to rise
- {死者数|ししゃすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce the death toll
- ⟦{累計|るいけい}→累計：08327_ruikei⟧{死者数|ししゃすう}: cumulative death toll

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧: victim — emphasizes that the deaths were a sacrifice or loss, and is more emotive
- ⟦{死亡者数|しぼうしゃすう}→死亡者数：30188_shiboushasuu⟧: number of deaths — stiffer and more bureaucratic; common in official statistics
